court_name: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
petitioner: Giri Textiles Thr Prop Chandrayya R. Pasnuri
respondent: Anthony Nadar And Jainam Silk Mills
government_department_involved: Labour Court, Thane; Industrial Court, Thane

directives.text: Acknowledge receipt of the High Court's order dismissing the writ petition and upholding the Labour and Industrial Courts' decisions.
Forward the High Court's order to the Labour Court, Thane for further proceedings in Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014.
Ensure Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 proceeds before the Labour Court, Thane as per law and on its merits, uninfluenced by previous observations except those concluded in the High Court judgment.
Expedite the disposal of Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 by the Labour Court, Thane, preferably within six months from the date of receipt of the High Court's order.
directives.deadline_text: Within 6 months from receipt of order

directives.text: Formally discharge Rule and dispose of any pending interim applications as per the High Court's order.

raw_summary: The High Court of Judicature at Bombay dismissed the writ petition, upholding the orders of the Labour Court and Industrial Court. The petitioner's objection regarding the non-maintainability of the application due to alleged non-compliance with Section 42(4) of the Maharashtra Industrial Relations Act, 1946, was not accepted. The Court held that the employer had not sufficiently demonstrated communication of the termination order and that the identity of the employer was itself in dispute, making strict procedural adherence difficult for the workman. The Labour Court was directed to proceed with Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 and endeavor to decide it within six months.
